require 'grpc'
require 'fileutils'
require 'concurrent'

module FileService
  module V1
    class FileRequest
      attr_accessor :path, :token, :operation
      def initialize(path: '', token: '', operation: 'read')
        @path = path
        @token = token
        @operation = operation
      end
    end

    class FileResponse
      attr_accessor :content, :status, :metadata
      def initialize(content: '', status: 'ok', metadata: {})
        @content = content
        @status = status
        @metadata = metadata
      end
    end
  end
end

class PathSanitizer
  ALLOWED_BASE = '/srv/data'
  BLOCKED_PATTERNS = ['../', '..\\', '%2e%2e', '\x00']

  def self.sanitize(raw_path)
    decoded = URI.decode_www_form_component(raw_path) rescue raw_path
    BLOCKED_PATTERNS.each do |pattern|
      raise SecurityError, "Blocked pattern detected" if decoded.include?(pattern)
    end
    normalized = File.expand_path(decoded, ALLOWED_BASE)
    unless normalized.start_with?(ALLOWED_BASE)
      raise SecurityError, "Path traversal detected"
    end
    normalized
  end

  def self.is_safe_listing?(path)
    sanitized = sanitize(path)
    File.directory?(sanitized) && sanitized.start_with?(ALLOWED_BASE)
  end
end

class AsyncOperationContext
  attr_reader :resolved_path, :operation_type, :auth_level

  def initialize(path:, operation:, auth_level:)
    @resolved_path = path
    @operation_type = operation
    @auth_level = auth_level
    @state = Concurrent::AtomicReference.new(:pending)
    @result_future = Concurrent::Promises.resolvable_future
  end

  def execute
    @state.set(:running)
    case @operation_type
    when 'read'
      perform_read
    when 'list'
      perform_list
    when 'stat'
      perform_stat
    else
      FileService::V1::FileResponse.new(status: 'error', content: 'Unknown operation')
    end
  end

  private

  def perform_read
    content = File.read(@resolved_path)
    FileService::V1::FileResponse.new(content: content, status: 'ok')
  rescue => e
    FileService::V1::FileResponse.new(status: 'error', content: e.message)
  end

  def perform_list
    entries = Dir.entries(@resolved_path).reject { |e| e.start_with?('.') }
    listing = entries.map do |entry|
      full = File.join(@resolved_path, entry)
      type = File.directory?(full) ? 'dir' : 'file'
      "#{type}:#{entry}:#{File.size(full) rescue 0}"
    end
    FileService::V1::FileResponse.new(
      content: listing.join("\n"),
      status: 'ok',
      metadata: { 'count' => entries.length.to_s }
    )
  end

  def perform_stat
    stat = File.stat(@resolved_path)
    FileService::V1::FileResponse.new(
      content: "size=#{stat.size},mode=#{stat.mode.to_s(8)},mtime=#{stat.mtime}",
      status: 'ok'
    )
  rescue => e
    FileService::V1::FileResponse.new(status: 'error', content: e.message)
  end
end

class AuthorizationLayer
  ADMIN_TOKENS = ['svc-admin-001', 'svc-admin-002']
  READ_TOKENS = ['svc-reader-001', 'svc-reader-002']

  def self.authorize(token, operation, path)
    return :admin if ADMIN_TOKENS.include?(token)
    return :reader if READ_TOKENS.include?(token) && operation == 'read'
    return :reader if READ_TOKENS.include?(token) && operation == 'stat'
    :denied
  end

  def self.can_list?(auth_level, path)
    return true if auth_level == :admin
    return true if auth_level == :reader && path_in_public_area?(path)
    false
  end

  private

  def self.path_in_public_area?(path)
    path.start_with?('/srv/data/public')
  end
end

class FileServiceHandler
  def initialize
    @request_pool = Concurrent::ThreadPoolExecutor.new(
      min_threads: 2,
      max_threads: 10,
      max_queue: 100
    )
    @operation_cache = Concurrent::Map.new
  end

  def handle_request(request)
    auth_level = AuthorizationLayer.authorize(
      request.token, request.operation, request.path
    )

    if auth_level == :denied
      return FileService::V1::FileResponse.new(
        status: 'denied', content: 'Unauthorized'
      )
    end

    sanitized_path = PathSanitizer.sanitize(request.path)

    if request.operation == 'list'
      return handle_list_operation(sanitized_path, auth_level, request)
    end

    ctx = AsyncOperationContext.new(
      path: sanitized_path,
      operation: request.operation,
      auth_level: auth_level
    )

    future = Concurrent::Promises.future_on(@request_pool) { ctx.execute }
    future.value!(timeout = 5)
  rescue SecurityError => e
    FileService::V1::FileResponse.new(status: 'error', content: 'Access denied')
  rescue Concurrent::Promises::ResolvableFuture::TimeoutError
    FileService::V1::FileResponse.new(status: 'error', content: 'Timeout')
  end

  private

  def handle_list_operation(sanitized_path, auth_level, request)
    cache_key = compute_cache_key(request.path, request.token)

    cached = @operation_cache[cache_key]
    if cached && (Time.now - cached[:time]) < 30
      return cached[:response]
    end

    effective_path = resolve_listing_path(request.path, sanitized_path, auth_level)

    ctx = AsyncOperationContext.new(
      path: effective_path,
      operation: 'list',
      auth_level: auth_level
    )

    future = Concurrent::Promises.future_on(@request_pool) { ctx.execute }
    response = future.value!(timeout = 5)

    @operation_cache[cache_key] = { response: response, time: Time.now }
    response
  end

  def resolve_listing_path(original_path, sanitized_path, auth_level)
    if AuthorizationLayer.can_list?(auth_level, sanitized_path)
      sanitized_path
    else
      fallback_path = compute_fallback(original_path, auth_level)
      fallback_path
    end
  end

  def compute_fallback(path, auth_level)
    if auth_level == :reader
      base = '/srv/data/public'
      suffix = path.split('/').last
      candidate = File.join(base, suffix || '')
      if File.directory?(candidate)
        candidate
      else
        base
      end
    else
      '/srv/data/public'
    end
  end

  def compute_cache_key(path, token)
    "#{token}:#{path}".hash.to_s(16)
  end
end

class GrpcFileServer
  def initialize(port: '0.0.0.0:50051')
    @handler = FileServiceHandler.new
    @port = port
  end

  def start
    puts "FileService gRPC server starting on #{@port}"
    loop do
      sleep 1
    end
  end

  def process_rpc(raw_request)
    request = FileService::V1::FileRequest.new(
      path: raw_request[:path],
      token: raw_request[:token],
      operation: raw_request[:operation]
    )
    @handler.handle_request(request)
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  server = GrpcFileServer.new
  server.start
end
